title: indigo_mount_lx200: a position readback failure during motion can end a successful GoTo in ALERT; abort may lose a kept ALERT while decelerating
description: (1) meade_read_position() failing once while the mount is slewing publishes ALERT after BUSY, which is then kept, so a GoTo that completes correctly ends as ALERT. (2) On real hardware an abort publishes BUSY while the mount decelerates, which clears a kept ALERT of the refused request; the simulator stops at once and does not show this. Part 2 needs hardware or a simulator with deceleration. Found while working on ticket 42b85be0-1f19-4607-b3c3-746e60317d17 (closed, commit a09e0f878), which introduced the kept coordinates ALERT in indigo_update_coordinates(): an ALERT published after a BUSY stays until the next BUSY. Reproduce in the driver's simulator suite before changing code.
